facts.text: I am putting this into my game.
I want the maps to be presented in a way that leaves it ambiguous what events fall on what timelines.
I want to keep the timeline mysterious until players piece together clues and events.
I typed a lot and I want suggestions, criticisms, or potential improvements on any of the 3 paths or the prologue I outlined.
I am interested in making things as good as they can be.
I love the idea of there being more, smaller splits in the timelines as different decisions are made.
I asked whether the 7 amplified zombie types we thought up yesterday should appear in certain timelines.
I am talking about the Jugernaut zombie type.
I am talking about the Hydra zombie type.
I am talking about the Skullcrawler zombie type.
I am talking about the Beserker zombie type.
I am talking about the Lasher zombie type.
I am talking about the Hoplite zombie type.
I am talking about the Fissionator zombie type.
I asked which zombie types should appear in all 3 paths and which should be more path-exclusive.
I asked for suggestions for maps or events that would fit into any of the 3 paths.
In Path 3, Marcus misses his gunshot meant to hit Surgey because Surgey notices Marcus acting fishy.
In Path 3, a stray bullet hits Dr. Penelope and causes her to bleed out.
In Path 3, Surgey fires back on Marcus and on the shocked Jillian.
In Path 3, Surgey kills both Marcus and Jillian.
In Path 3, Surgey runs because he lacks the manpower to fight the zombies and lacks the courage to face the US government after the death of three government officials at his hands.
In Path 3, the spread from the lab is uncontained because the military was never alerted to the outbreak at the main lab.
In Path 3, the military never checks on other labs dotted throughout North and South America.
In Path 3, more sources of spread for the parasite and zombie masses occur because other labs are not checked.
In Path 3, the Americas are crippled into essentially an exclusion zone.
In Path 3, small parasite outbreaks begin being reported across the coasts of Africa, Europe, and Russia.
In Path 3, boats carrying hidden parasites or infected corpses cross while fleeing the carnage.
In Path 3, maps follow groups of survivors trying to piece together society while not being eaten alive.
In Path 3, Surgey meets a group of survivors while trapped in a bunker somewhere.
In Path 3, Surgey manipulates the group by telling them there is a large settlement unaffected in Northern Canada.
In Path 3, Surgey instructs the group to carpet bomb a border around the Northern Canada region to keep them safe from future hordes.
In Path 3, the bombs are filled with parasites.
In Path 3, the bombs are aimed at the USSR.
In Path 3, Surgey sees the USSR as having abandoned him in American hands and refusing to do anything to stop the parasite in the Americas.
In Path 3, this results in apocalypse in Europe, Asia, and Africa.
In Path 3, this spells the end of the world.
